deliverables: 12 months of frontend and backend maintenance and development
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub work, hardware wallet support, and wallet data export improvements
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
request.what: Treasury withdrawal for 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements, including frontend/backend work, infrastructure, support, admin, and audits/oversight.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover a 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027.
The proposal states Eternl costs around $420,000 per year and funds 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
The budget allocates 55% to frontend, 25% to backend, 5% to support, 13% to admin, and 2% to audits.
Eternl plans to convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The proposal says periodic independent audits in February 2027 and August 2027 will review fund receipt, custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and treasury refunds or repayments.
Eternl plans Personal and Company Pro plans at $96/year and $360/year, and claims roughly 5,500 paying users would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
The proposal states Eternl has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
The proposal claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The proposal states the main Eternl UI will not be open-source, though some libraries used by Eternl will be published via the npm registry.
The proposal states that without enough funding, Eternl may let go of developers, scale down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, or remove the free option.

summary: The document requests ₳2.35M for a 12-month Eternl sustainability period, provides a high-level budget and repayment/audit plan, and makes several material adoption and sustainability claims, but many key claims are asserted without independent evidence in the supplied anchor text.
